text:
maria: Heads up — onboarding bramble13b:v2 (13B, int4 qkv) on dedicated pool. Quant v2 looks OK for perf, but we hit OOMs when callers set max_new_tokens > 256. Repro on a 48GB GPU node. Any quick hypotheses?

sanjay: can you paste the exact deploy + runtime flags? is prefetch on?

maria: deploy command: `deploy --model bramble13b:v2 --quant int4 --prefetch true --pool dedicated-bramble --replicas 2`

ben: grabbing runtime logs from the instance, seen repeatedly: 
```
E 8109876601 runtime: allocation failed: cudaMalloc failed (out of memory)
W 8109876601 kv_cache: attempted grow to 1.2GB -> failed
I 8109876602 request=abcd1234 max_new_tokens=512 prompt_len=128
```

ellie: hmm slab fragmentation is a likely culprit. int4 reduces model params but our per-request KV allocation still scales with max_new_tokens. If prefetched slots + windowing are large, we can fragment 48GB quickly.

maria: we have `kv_prefetch_slots=6` in the model config (default). maybe too many for this model?

sanjay: try dropping to 2 and enable slot compactor. also set `prefetch.max_window_tokens=1024` so we bound per-request allocation.

ben: quick patch I pushed to the canary: 
```
model_config:
  kv_prefetch_slots: 2
  prefetch:
    max_window_tokens: 1024
  slot_compactor:
    enabled: true
    free_threshold_bytes: 134217728
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for bramble13b:v2 -> dedicated-bramble (2/2)

maria: after canary patch, reproduced locally with a stress script that fires 8 concurrent requests (prompt 128 + max_new_tokens 512). Memory peak lowered ~6GB and no OOM so far. latency stable within SLO. :thumbsup:

ellie: good signal. still want to run perf sweep: try batch_size=1..4, and test adaptive_window=true vs false. For this model, adaptive_window + slot_compactor usually reduces peak by ~10-15%.

sanjay: noted. also consider adding a fail-safe: if memory pressure > 90% then reject requests with max_new_tokens > 256 on this pool (temporary). That avoids prod blowups while we dial defaults.

ben: logging the experiment plan in the onboarding doc: /docs/onboard/bramble13b/experiments.md (link). Will run nightly sweep with these configs.

maria: one weirdness — customers still occasionally set max_new_tokens=1024 via API. Should we enforce an account-level quota?

ellie: yes, we have `policy.max_output_tokens` that can be applied per-tenant. For now set policy:max_output_tokens=512 for default tier.

maria: action items: 1) keep kv_prefetch_slots=2 in model config (maria) 2) run batch/adaptive-window sweep (ben) 3) apply soft quota policy for default tier (sanjay) 4) monitor canary for 24h (ops-bot)

ops-bot: monitor-bot: canary metrics streaming: memory_peak 38.9GB -> stable, OOM rate 0/1000 -> OK

ben: one more note — quant v2 int4 showed ~8% CPU overhead in kernel scheduling under small microbatches; if we go with batch_size=4 watch tail latency. Plan to instrument per-token CPU and GPU kernel durations.

maria: thanks all — will follow up in the onboarding doc with the final recommended defaults (kv_prefetch_slots=2, slot_compactor:enabled, prefetch.max_window_tokens=1024, policy.max_output_tokens=512).
